name: Bow & Squeak
description:
Whenever you interact with a deity or spirit for the first time, they will assume you are a non-threatening servant and will continue to think so unless you target them with an Attack, speak rudely to them, disobey orders they give you or otherwise anger them.

While you maintain this status:

  • All your Opposed Skill Checks against the deity or spirit are Favored.

  • Whenever you use the Help action to enhance an ally's Skill Check, they get a +2d bonus instead of the normal +1d.
